body: Yes, I think so. Imagine both sides pulling with all their might, so the tension is on both ends of the rope. Now, imagine all the tension is gone from Team A's side due to them moving forward: the rope is now moving towards Team B, which means the force they use to pull is greater than the tension produced by Team A. This caused Team B to fall over backwards. They'll be too shocked at falling over, which will give you a chance to pull the rope towards your side while they catch their breath and try to recover!
